-- [마을 실물 검증] 현재 항구의 주민 동선 사전검사와 경제시설 예약 면적을 확인한다.
local scene=assert(workspace:FindFirstChild("PortScene"),"TOWN_SCENE_MISSING")
local relocated=scene:GetAttribute("NpcRouteRelocated")
local stopped=scene:GetAttribute("NpcRouteBlocked")
assert(type(relocated)=="number" and type(stopped)=="number","TOWN_NPC_ROUTE_PREFLIGHT_MISSING")
local lots={}
for _,obj in scene:GetChildren() do
 if obj:IsA("Model") and string.sub(obj.Name,1,12)=="EconomySite_" then
  local pos=obj:GetPivot().Position
  for _,other in lots do
   assert(math.abs(pos.X-other.X)>=36 or math.abs(pos.Z-other.Z)>=36,"TOWN_ECONOMY_LOT_OVERLAP:"..obj.Name)
  end
  table.insert(lots,pos)
 end
end
-- [실제 Studio 정면] 기존 주민을 새로 만들지 않고 표시 중인 R15 머리/몸통 전방을 비교한다.
local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
local checked, corrected=0,0
for _,resident in scene:GetDescendants() do
 if resident:IsA("Model") and resident.Name=="Villager" then
  local head,torso=resident:FindFirstChild("Head"),resident:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
  if head and torso and head:IsA("BasePart") and torso:IsA("BasePart")
   and (not camera or (camera.CFrame.Position - torso.Position).Magnitude < 160) then
   local alignment=head.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(torso.CFrame.LookVector)
   assert(alignment>0.15,"TOWN_NPC_FACE_REVERSED:"..tostring(resident:GetAttribute("AppearanceProfession"))..":"..tostring(alignment))
   checked+=1
   -- [실제 주민 지면] R15 리그 중심이 아니라 발바닥이 광장 지면 아래로 내려갔는지 판정한다.
   local leftFoot,rightFoot=resident:FindFirstChild("LeftFoot"),resident:FindFirstChild("RightFoot")
   if leftFoot and rightFoot and leftFoot:IsA("BasePart") and rightFoot:IsA("BasePart") then
    local footY=math.min(leftFoot.Position.Y-leftFoot.Size.Y*.5,rightFoot.Position.Y-rightFoot.Size.Y*.5)
    assert(footY>-0.85,"TOWN_NPC_BELOW_GROUND:"..tostring(resident:GetAttribute("AppearanceProfession"))..":"..tostring(footY))
   end
   if resident:GetAttribute("NpcFaceReversed") then corrected+=1 end
  end
 end
end
assert(checked>=3,"TOWN_NPC_FACE_AUDIT_NO_VISIBLE_RESIDENTS")
-- [중앙광장 공터 실제 검증] 보행용 바닥·도로와 주민은 허용하고 고정 건축물·조형물·가판대는 금지한다.
assert(scene:GetAttribute("CentralPlazaReserved")==true and scene:GetAttribute("CentralPlazaClearRadius")==26,"TOWN_CENTRAL_PLAZA_RESERVATION_MISSING")
local plazaChecked=0
for _,obj in scene:GetChildren() do
 if obj:IsA("Model") and not obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
  local box,size=obj:GetBoundingBox()
  local dx,dz=box.Position.X+6,box.Position.Z
  assert(dx*dx+dz*dz>=26*26,"PZ:"..obj.Name..":"..math.floor(dx)..","..math.floor(dz).."|TOWN_CENTRAL_PLAZA_STRUCTURE:"..obj.Name)
  plazaChecked+=1
 elseif obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Transparency<0.8 and obj.Size.X<100 and obj.Size.Z<100 then
  -- 원형 광장 포장판은 Y 축으로 세운 Cylinder를 90도 눕힌 형태라 Size.Y가 큰 바닥이다.
  local cf,sz=obj.CFrame,obj.Size
  local vertical=math.abs(cf.RightVector.Y)*sz.X+math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y)*sz.Y+math.abs(cf.LookVector.Y)*sz.Z
  if vertical>1.8 then
   local dx,dz=obj.Position.X+6,obj.Position.Z
   assert(dx*dx+dz*dz>=24*24,"TOWN_CENTRAL_PLAZA_PART:"..obj.Name)
  end
 end
end
assert(plazaChecked>10,"TOWN_CENTRAL_PLAZA_AUDIT_EMPTY")
-- [그래픽 인과 실측] 판정은 바꾸지 않고, 실제 객체 단위로 공중 부유·집 겹침을 기록한다(책임 함수 수정 근거).
local floats,overlaps,houses={}, {}, {}
local rp=RaycastParams.new() rp.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
for _,obj in scene:GetChildren() do
 if obj:IsA("Model") and not obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
  local ok,box,size=pcall(obj.GetBoundingBox,obj)
  if ok and box then
   local bottom=box.Position-Vector3.new(0,size.Y*.5,0)
   rp.FilterDescendantsInstances={obj}
   local hit=workspace:Raycast(bottom+Vector3.new(0,.2,0),Vector3.new(0,-40,0),rp)
   local gap=hit and (bottom.Y-hit.Position.Y) or 40
   if gap>1.2 then table.insert(floats,{n=obj.Name,g=gap,x=math.floor(box.Position.X),z=math.floor(box.Position.Z),a=tostring(obj:GetAttribute("AssetName") or obj:GetAttribute("Asset") or "")}) end
   if obj.Name=="HarborHouse" then table.insert(houses,{box=box,size=size,n=obj}) end
  end
 end
end
for i=1,#houses do for j=i+1,#houses do
 local a1,b1=houses[i],houses[j]
 local ox=math.min(a1.box.Position.X+a1.size.X/2,b1.box.Position.X+b1.size.X/2)-math.max(a1.box.Position.X-a1.size.X/2,b1.box.Position.X-b1.size.X/2)
 local oz=math.min(a1.box.Position.Z+a1.size.Z/2,b1.box.Position.Z+b1.size.Z/2)-math.max(a1.box.Position.Z-a1.size.Z/2,b1.box.Position.Z-b1.size.Z/2)
 if ox>0 and oz>0 then
  local small=math.min(a1.size.X*a1.size.Z,b1.size.X*b1.size.Z)
  if ox*oz>small*.3 then table.insert(overlaps,math.floor(a1.box.Position.X)..","..math.floor(a1.box.Position.Z).."~"..math.floor(b1.box.Position.X)..","..math.floor(b1.box.Position.Z).."="..math.floor(ox*oz/small*100).."%") end
 end
end end
table.sort(floats,function(p,q) return p.g>q.g end)
local ft={} for k=1,math.min(6,#floats) do local f=floats[k] table.insert(ft,f.n..(f.a~="" and ("/"..f.a) or "").."@"..f.x..","..f.z.."+"..string.format("%.1f",f.g)) end
local graphicAudit=string.format(" GRAPHIC_AUDIT floating=%d [%s] houseOverlap=%d [%s]",#floats,table.concat(ft,";"),#overlaps,table.concat(overlaps,";",1,math.min(6,#overlaps)))
-- [캐릭터 외형 실측] 판정 불변. 표시·원거리 생략·누락 원인을 실제 주민 모델에서 읽는다.
local oStates,oVis,oReq,oLod,oMiss,oHair,oN={},0,0,0,{},0,0
for _,m in scene:GetDescendants() do
 if m:IsA("Model") and m:GetAttribute("OutfitRequiredCount") then
  oN+=1
  local st=tostring(m:GetAttribute("NpcAppearanceState") or m:GetAttribute("MobAppearanceState"))
  oStates[st]=(oStates[st] or 0)+1
  oVis+=m:GetAttribute("OutfitVisibleCount") or 0 oReq+=m:GetAttribute("OutfitRequiredCount") or 0 oLod+=m:GetAttribute("OutfitLodHiddenCount") or 0
  if m:GetAttribute("NpcVisibleHairMesh") then oHair+=1 end
  local miss=m:GetAttribute("OutfitMissing")
  if miss then for w in string.gmatch(miss,"[^,]+") do oMiss[w]=(oMiss[w] or 0)+1 end end
 end
end
local sl,ml={},{} for k,v in oStates do table.insert(sl,k.."="..v) end for k,v in oMiss do table.insert(ml,k.."x"..v) end
table.sort(ml)
graphicAudit=graphicAudit..string.format(" OUTFIT_AUDIT models=%d states=[%s] visible=%d/%d lodHidden=%d hairMesh=%d missing=[%s]",oN,table.concat(sl,";"),oVis,oReq,oLod,oHair,table.concat(ml,";",1,math.min(10,#ml)))
-- [도시 분포 실측] 광장 중심(-6,0)에서 고정 건물(모델) 거리 분포와 구역 이름별 수. 판정 불변.
local bands={0,0,0,0,0,0} local edges={40,80,120,170,240}
local houseBands={0,0,0,0,0,0}
for _,obj in scene:GetChildren() do
 if obj:IsA("Model") and not obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and not obj:GetAttribute("AnimalSpecies") then
  local ok,box=pcall(obj.GetBoundingBox,obj)
  if ok and box then
   local r=math.sqrt((box.Position.X+6)^2+box.Position.Z^2) local b=6
   for i,e in edges do if r<e then b=i break end end

  end
 end
end
